detail.body:
- [x] I, the PR author, have personally reviewed every line of this PR.

## What does this PR do?

Update agents.md and PR template to account for code origin.

Linked issue: [MCORE-1013](https://linear.app/nvidia/issue/MCORE-1013/add-external-code-provenance-requirements-to-the-pr-template-and)
detail.title: Add external code provenance requirements to PR template and agent guidance

files.patch:
@@ -14,6 +14,18 @@ For PRs from open-source community contributors:
 
 Linked issue: <!-- e.g. Fixes #1234 / Related to #1234 -->
 
+## Code provenance
+
+You should always make a best effort to avoid copying code from other
+ repositories. In exceptional cases in which this is unavoidable and you copied
+ or adapted code from an external source, provide the following details and
+ copy to the file header:
+
+- Source URL, revision, and original file(s):
+- Files in this PR containing the copied or adapted code:
+- Applicable license(s):
+- Required copyright notices and attribution, and where they are retained or added:
+
 ## Contribution process
 
 ### Pre-checks

@@ -38,6 +38,16 @@ skill keyword — infer it from the artifact you read.
   or approvals.
 - Read [docs/developer/contribute.md](./docs/developer/contribute.md) for the full contribution policy, including code style, commit message conventions, and issue guidelines.
 
+### Code Provenance
+
+- Best effort to avoid copying code from other repositories. Implement changes
+  independently.
+- If copying code is necessary, add the source URL, revision, and license to
+ all headers of files that contain such code. In addition, ensure the
+ "Code provenance" section is filled in within the PR description.
+- Preserve all required license and copyright notices and attribution for any
+  external code in the proposed changes.
+
 ### Code Quality
 
 - After editing imports in any Python files, always run `uv run isort` on those files to fix import order before committing.
